About this demonstration

Swimming, taekwondo and robotics are listed as co-curricular activities on the school’s website. Paid packages, schedules and eligibility are not confirmed. All amounts, discounts and payment plans are examples.

Pay in full with a 5% example discount, or split the undiscounted amount into 2, 3 or 4 payments. Subsequent payments start on 8 November 2026, then monthly. After payment, Stream displays confirmation and the downloadable invoice.
